biggest_catch: Must open in person at an AB&T branch (South Dakota/Minnesota footprint) with a $50 minimum opening deposit; 2 direct deposits totaling $500+ and 20 debit card transactions within 90 days; $25 fee if the account is closed within 90 days.
catches: Open a new AB&T checking account IN PERSON at an AB&T branch (eligible account: Totally Free Checking); $50 minimum opening deposit.
Within 90 days of account opening: 2 direct deposits totaling at least $500; enroll in eStatements; complete at least 20 debit card transactions.
P2P payments (Zelle) and external bank-to-bank ACH transfers do not count as direct deposits.
Bonus deposited into the new account within 45 days after qualifications are met.
$25 early closure fee if the checking account is closed within 90 days of opening.
Not available to existing AB&T checking customers, those whose accounts closed within the last 6 months, or those who closed with a negative balance in the last 3 years.
Limit one new checking account opening bonus every two years from the last bonus payout date; one bonus per account and per customer.
Bonus is considered interest and will be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Not available to non-resident aliens or foreign entities.
Offer runs September 1 – October 31, 2026 and can be withdrawn at any time without notice.

steps: Open a new AB&T Totally Free Checking account in person at an AB&T branch during the promo period (Sept 1 – Oct 31, 2026) with a $50 minimum opening deposit.
Within 90 days of account opening: receive 2 direct deposits totaling at least $500 (P2P/Zelle and bank-to-bank ACH do not count).
Complete at least 20 debit card transactions on the account within the 90-day window.
The $500 bonus is deposited into the new account within 45 days after the qualifications are met; keep the account open at least 90 days to avoid the $25 early closure fee.
